_about: Public-domain Edward Robinson (1794-1863, Union Theological Seminary, founder of biblical geography) for the Word Hoard: Biblical Researches in Palestine, Mount Sinai and Arabia Petraea (3 vols, 1841), Later Biblical Researches (1856), Physical Geography of the Holy Land (1865), his Greek and English Lexicon of the New Testament (1836), and his Harmonies of the Gospels in Greek (1845) and English (1846), from Internet Archive scans. His Gesenius translation is another man's lexicon and is not shelved. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
